title: Current evidence and recipe-owned state

nodes.summary: Plugin connectors acquire typed evidence; the KB interprets it
nodes.detail: Plugin source connectors acquire and normalize provider data into typed views, and KB functions interpret those views into candidate knowledge. Provider grouping/pagination belongs to the plugin; KB-specific classification belongs to the KB.
sections: Decision

realised.evidence: Typed acquisition proven in #96 (seq 78) and run natively in #99/#100; KB-side interpretation via typed tools composing captured plugin reads arrives in #107

nodes.summary: Evidence identity includes plugin, named connector instance and configuration
nodes.detail: Evidence is identified by producing plugin, named connector instance, its configuration and method, so two instances of the same connector type never share evidence; secret values are never part of identity.
sections: Decision

realised.evidence: PR #95 keys evidence per connector instance with per-instance documents; two-instance journeys in #100/#101

nodes.summary: Evidence is an ignored local cache, replaceable on refresh
nodes.detail: Evidence lives in an ignored checkout-local cache that a refresh may replace; Kyyn keeps source identity, fetch time, producer identity and references with it, not eternal schema custody.
sections: Decision

realised.evidence: No evidence store existed before seq 76 replaced this with retained fetch history

nodes.summary: Snapshot-scoped typed pages with opaque cursors and EvidenceProblem
nodes.detail: Reads go through a fixed EvidenceSnapshot exposing typed pages with opaque cursors bound to the query and snapshot; replacement, incompleteness and producer changes are EvidenceProblem data, not storage failures.
sections: Decision

realised.evidence: readEvidencePage/PageRequest never appeared in code; removed at seq 76

nodes.summary: Acquisition checkpoints advance only after persistence; partial runs distinguishable
nodes.detail: Acquisition checkpoints advance only after fetched data is persisted and incomplete runs stay distinguishable from complete snapshots; a checkpoint is not proof that evidence became accepted knowledge.
sections: Decision

realised.evidence: Replaced by single complete-batch publication (no checkpoint lifecycle) at seq 76 before any implementation

nodes.summary: No kernel review queue; KBs model completeness with ordinary facts
nodes.detail: Kyyn has no kernel-enforced queue of evidence awaiting review, dismissal or acceptance; a KB that needs to prove every item was considered models that with ordinary facts, queries and validation. Interrupted curation stays repeatable through stable IDs.
sections: Decision

realised.evidence: Negative constraint; no review-queue machinery existed in code at founding

nodes.summary: Evolution entries may read or acquire evidence via snapshot refs
nodes.detail: An evolution entry may invoke a plugin to read an existing evidence snapshot or explicitly acquire new evidence, with generated proxies carrying a snapshot reference so later pages never silently switch; candidate checking uses captured inputs, not fresh evidence.
sections: Decision

realised.evidence: Effectful evolution acquisition was never built; ADR 0010 made evolution execution pure and the section was deleted at seq 97

nodes.summary: Provenance is declared through each step's Rationale with EvidenceRefs
nodes.detail: Supporting provenance is the explanation plus EvidenceRef list in each evolution step's Rationale; reading evidence does not cite it, fetching creates no review obligation, and the kernel does not infer support from call traces.
sections: Decision

realised.evidence: PR #33 adds Rationale/EvidenceRef/StepObservation with ordered rationale in the SDK

nodes.summary: Citations carry durable plugin-chosen source identity, not versions or hashes
nodes.detail: An archived citation retains producer/connector identity, the plugin's best available scoped source ID and useful links, meaning 'this source supports the rationale' rather than an immutable historical version; no versions, fingerprints or content hashes are required.
sections: Decision

realised.evidence: PR #95 assembles EvidenceRef citations host-side from plugin-supplied references, without fingerprints

nodes.summary: Plugin change invalidates evidence and refetches; accepted facts survive
nodes.detail: When a plugin changes (by package identity, not just schema), affected evidence and bindings are invalidated, consumers repaired and evidence refetched, with no per-run schema negotiation; accepted facts are never deleted because evidence expired.
sections: Updates and alternatives

realised.evidence: PR #95 binds stored evidence to producer PackageIdentity and refuses producer-mismatched reads

nodes.summary: EvidenceRef is a durable citation value, distinct from snapshot handles
nodes.detail: EvidenceRef {producer, connector, source, references} is the shared durable citation value; EvidenceSnapshotRef separately selects cached data, and a citation must never silently become a cache-lookup handle.
sections: Decision

realised.evidence: PR #33 ships EvidenceRef in the SDK as durable source references, not live snapshot handles

nodes.summary: Plugins declare New/Updated/Removed deltas, published as one complete batch
nodes.detail: The plugin decides which items are new, updated (full replacement payload) or removed versus its prior snapshot; the host checks delta consistency but never derives changes. One complete batch publishes atomically against an expected base; failure publishes nothing and there is no partial-run lifecycle.
sections: Decision / A fetch changes an evidence snapshot

realised.evidence: Store consistency in #95 (seq 77); native acquisition publishing complete batches in #99

nodes.summary: Retain every successful fetch delta; explicit historical evidence selection
nodes.detail: Every successful fetch and its delta payloads are retained until explicit deletion, with CurrentEvidence/AtFetch selection, reconstruction from deltas and per-invocation fixed selections, replacing the replaceable-cache model.
sections: Decision / Retained fetches and explicit selection

realised.evidence: PR #95 implements retained Dhall history, AtFetch selection and reconstruction

nodes.summary: Payload-free change summaries with host-assembled citations
nodes.detail: Investigation sees only payload-free change summaries (fetch, kind, item, citation); the host assembles EvidenceRef from producer/instance identity, item ID and plugin references, using a removed item's preceding references.
sections: Decision / Retained fetches and explicit selection

realised.evidence: Code in #95; CLI change listing in #101 (seq 82)

nodes.summary: Fix per-instance evidence selections for the whole invocation
nodes.detail: Named bindings select current evidence by default, resolved and held per instance for the whole invocation; explicit historical selections are invocation inputs, never edits to generated connector values.
sections: Decision / Retained fetches and explicit selection

realised.evidence: PR #99 broker binds guest evidence reads to the selected snapshot

nodes.summary: Investigate through typed plugin methods and KB tools; no generic viewEvidence
nodes.detail: Plugins advertise typed documented methods (viewEmail, getAttachments) that interpret captured payloads, composed by KB tools across plugins; there is no generic viewEvidence and viewing never silently fetches.
sections: Decision / Investigation and curation

realised.evidence: PR #107 composes captured plugin reads in typed KB tools (after #106 local-file content methods)

nodes.summary: Curation progress is a KB-authored cursor advanced only by acceptance
nodes.detail: Curation progress is ordinary KB data such as a workflow-specific last-curated fetch, updated with facts in an evolution and advanced only by acceptance; there is no global curated flag or per-item review queue.
sections: Decision / Investigation and curation

realised.evidence: Never implemented; replaced by host-owned recipe acknowledgements at seq 89

nodes.summary: Producer change keeps old bytes uninterpreted; refetch starts empty
nodes.detail: After a plugin change, retained old bytes are not reinterpreted under the new contract; a refetch starts from an empty compatible snapshot and old curation cursors cannot cross that boundary.
sections: Updates and alternatives

realised.evidence: PR #95 archives old documents and requires empty-base publication on producer change

nodes.summary: Folder connector: directory plus recursive flag, complete enumeration required
nodes.detail: The first folder connector config is only directory and recursive flag (no globs); it must enumerate successfully before treating missing paths as removals, and an unreadable directory is an error.
sections: Decision / A fetch changes an evidence snapshot

realised.evidence: Folder fixture in #96 (seq 78); FolderConfig in the first-party local-file package in #100

nodes.summary: One locked, atomically replaced Dhall document per connector instance
nodes.detail: Each instance's evidence lives in one typed .kyyn/evidence/<plugin>-<hex instance>/state.dhall document recording producer identity, under a native file lock with atomic replacement, with the shared .kyyn/.gitignore ignore rule.
sections: Decision / Retained fetches and explicit selection

realised.evidence: PR #95 implements the per-instance Dhall document with filelock and atomic replace

nodes.summary: Acquisition only uses configured instances from the checked accepted root
nodes.detail: Evidence fetching uses a configured instance from the checked accepted root; a draft evolution's configuration can be inspected but cannot start or advance evidence before acceptance.
sections: Decision / A fetch changes an evidence snapshot

realised.evidence: PR #101 'evidence fetch' uses the checked accepted root only

nodes.summary: EvidenceStore is a porcelain capability over scoped DocumentPersistence
nodes.detail: EvidenceStore's interpreter owns delta application, producer selection and expected-base publication, using ADR 0003's scoped DocumentPersistence for native IO with one lock spanning read, check, encode and replace.
sections: Decision / Retained fetches and explicit selection

realised.evidence: PR #102 introduces semantic EvidenceStore over DocumentPersistence preserving the lock

nodes.summary: Load the selected snapshot once per invocation; release lock before guest code
nodes.detail: For one plugin invocation the host loads the selected snapshot once and answers later reads from that immutable value, releasing the store lock before guest code or acquisition.
sections: Decision / Retained fetches and explicit selection

realised.evidence: PR #102 adds invocation-scoped evidence snapshots (loadEvidenceSnapshot)

nodes.summary: Keep only the latest captured value per evidence item
nodes.detail: Each instance has one latest captured state; a successful fetch replaces, adds and removes items and persistent storage holds only current values. Historical selection, payload replay, baselines and producer archives are removed: Kyyn keeps a KB current, not a forensic archive.
sections: Decision / One current captured value per evidence item

realised.evidence: PR #104 implements latest-only storage, discarding superseded payloads

nodes.summary: Connectors supply an opaque nonempty fingerprint per evidence item
nodes.detail: Every evidence item carries a connector-supplied nonempty EvidenceFingerprint, an opaque equality token for captured content (content hash, provider revision or stable projection); updates with an unchanged fingerprint are refused as invalid deltas.
sections: Decision / One current captured value per evidence item

realised.evidence: PR #104 adds fingerprinted Evidence and native content hashing

nodes.summary: Each invocation reads one immutable view of the latest capture
nodes.detail: A plugin invocation reads one immutable in-memory view of the latest capture whose lifetime the host owns; refresh does not change a loaded invocation, and unfetched or incompatible instances are actionable errors, not empty input.
sections: Decision / Atomic refresh and invocation-local reads

realised.evidence: PR #104 loads current evidence once before guest execution

nodes.summary: Retain payload-free fetch change markers to support curation cursors
nodes.detail: Fetch identity, predecessor, time and lightweight per-item change markers (kind, ID, fingerprint, citation) are retained until clearing to support KB curation cursors; unknown cursors are errors, never empty results.
sections: Decision / Payload-free change tracking

realised.evidence: PR #104 implements payload-free history and cursor diagnostics

nodes.summary: Plugin change: refetch replaces capture and markers; scoped clear
nodes.detail: Evidence is bound to producing plugin source and contract; after an update the refetch replaces the instance's capture and marker history, and 'evidence clear PLUGIN INSTANCE' discards local cache without touching accepted facts.
sections: Decision / Plugin changes and cache replacement

realised.evidence: PR #104 adds producer reset and runtime-free evidence clear

nodes.summary: Recipes are KB-owned task identities with agent instructions
nodes.detail: A recipe is a KB-owned identity plus agent instructions (e.g. sync todos) in the accepted root, changed through evolutions; it is not a scheduled job, entry point or kernel-managed workflow, and an evolution names at most one.
sections: Decision / Recipes name the task, not an execution workflow

realised.evidence: Pure types in #111 (seq 90); persisted declarations in #112

nodes.summary: Evolutions explicitly declare batch or item acknowledgements per recipe
nodes.detail: An evolution result may declare EntireBatch or IndividualRecords acknowledgements for its one recipe via withCuration; they are never inferred from reads or citations, and the host resolves them against the named fetch during preparation.
sections: Decision / Declare what was handled; derive progress in the host

realised.evidence: PR #113 implements withCuration and preparation-time resolution

nodes.summary: Host-owned Git-tracked register of acknowledged ID/fingerprint states
nodes.detail: The host owns a Git-tracked Dhall register mapping recipe and instance to producer plus acknowledged ID/fingerprint states, published with facts at acceptance; fetching never changes it.
sections: Decision / Accepted progress and net pending evidence

realised.evidence: PR #112 persists host-owned curation progress

nodes.summary: Pending work is the net difference between acknowledged and current state
nodes.detail: Pending discovery compares each item's acknowledged state with the current capture (net New/Updated/Removed), without fetch history; an empty result does not mean the task is complete.
sections: Decision / Accepted progress and net pending evidence

realised.evidence: Pure comparison in #111 (seq 90); CLI pending discovery in #114

nodes.summary: Recipes in kb.dhall manifest; register at root/curation.dhall
nodes.detail: Recipe declarations persist as a required recipes field in root/kb.dhall and the register at root/curation.dhall, excluded from target code and absent meaning empty.
sections: Decision / Recipes name the task, not an execution workflow
Decision / Accepted progress and net pending evidence

realised.evidence: PR #112 implements manifest recipes and root/curation.dhall

nodes.summary: Canonical sorted Dhall register schema with strict validation
nodes.detail: The register document is a sorted list of recipe/plugin/instance/producer/contract entries with acknowledged ID/fingerprint lists; duplicates and empty fields are refused as curation.invalid-register.
sections: Decision / Accepted progress and net pending evidence

realised.evidence: PR #112 adds the canonical register codec

nodes.summary: Resolve acknowledgement scopes by replaying the fetch marker chain
nodes.detail: Preparation projects the stored marker chain to reconstruct item states through the named fetch, records the stored producer, and gives concrete curation.* repair diagnostics.
sections: Decision / Declare what was handled; derive progress in the host

realised.evidence: PR #113 resolves fixed fetch scopes from retained markers

nodes.summary: CLI recipe list/show/pending via a read-only RecipeStore
nodes.detail: root recipe list/show/pending list are served by a read-only RecipeStore over Git; pending discovery prepares the connector and compares register and capture from the same revision.
sections: Decision / Recipes name the task, not an execution workflow

realised.evidence: PR #114 adds the CLI commands and RecipeStore

nodes.summary: Recipes are typed KB facts edited by ordinary evolutions
nodes.detail: Recipes become identified Fact Recipe data in a KnowledgeBase wrapper, edited with the same collection operations, rationale and review as domain facts and persisted in root/recipes.dhall rather than the manifest.
sections: Decision / Recipes name the task, not an execution workflow

realised.evidence: SDK values in #117 (seq 95); full integration in #118

nodes.summary: Recipe changes are a distinct review report case
nodes.detail: The host derives recipe additions/updates/removals by ID and reports them as a RecipeChange case beside domain fact changes, in archive version 3.
sections: Decision / Recipes name the task, not an execution workflow

realised.evidence: PR #118 reports recipe changes distinctly (archive v3)

nodes.summary: 'evidence list' shows current IDs and fingerprints only
nodes.detail: evidence list PLUGIN INSTANCE lists the latest capture's IDs and fingerprints without payloads or recipe filtering and changes no curation progress.
sections: Decision / Payload-free change tracking

realised.evidence: PR #138 adds evidence list

nodes.summary: Local-file fingerprint is host SHA-256 over framed path and bytes
nodes.detail: Host file acquisition returns lowercase SHA-256 over the length-framed UTF-8 path and captured bytes, used directly by the folder connector.
sections: Decision / One current captured value per evidence item

realised.evidence: PR #140 implements the framed SHA-256 token

nodes.summary: Fetch IDs are random 8-hex tokens, redrawn on collision
nodes.detail: New fetch IDs are eight lowercase hex digits from 32 random bits, redrawn on collision with the instance's retained history.
sections: Decision / Payload-free change tracking

realised.evidence: PR #142 implements random IDs with collision redraw

nodes.summary: Citations name the instance and are labelled declared, not verified
nodes.detail: EvidenceRef's field becomes instanceName and human reports label citations as declared, not verified evidence.
sections: Decision / Declared provenance

realised.evidence: PR #142 renames the field and labels report citations

nodes.summary: Connectors may advertise typed per-fetch options, checked before invocation
nodes.detail: evidence fetch accepts an optional value of the connector's advertised options type, checked before execution; options are non-secret invocation data recorded as normalized Dhall in fetch history, and the connector owns defaulting.
sections: Decision / Connector-owned fetch options
Decision / Payload-free change tracking

realised.evidence: PR #145 implements typed fetch options, discovery and history

nodes.summary: Graph calendar: full events listing with changeKey and modified-time bounds
nodes.detail: The first calendar connector paginates the full events collection (not calendarView), uses event ID and changeKey, optionally bounds upserts by lastModifiedDateTime, and detects removals only against the complete unfiltered listing.
sections: Decision / Microsoft Graph calendar acquisition

realised.evidence: PR #147 adds the Graph calendar source with full-list removals and bounds

nodes.summary: Recipes are OpenAgent instructions or ClosedAgent flow references
nodes.detail: The Recipe type becomes OpenAgent instructions or ClosedAgent naming a callable flow (ADR 0028 executes it); old instruction-only payloads decode as OpenAgent and switching modes is a recipe update.
sections: Decision / Recipes name the curation task

realised.evidence: PR #167 represents and typechecks closed recipes

nodes.summary: Producer mismatch yields Reconciliation with the full current ID set
nodes.detail: When a refetched producer differs from accepted recipe progress, pending discovery returns Reconciliation with the current IDs rather than a fake delta; only EntireBatch can establish the new producer.
sections: Decision / Accepted progress and net pending evidence

realised.evidence: PR #174 returns explicit Reconciliation for producer changes

nodes.summary: Payload availability (Available/Truncated) is independent of evidence changes
nodes.detail: Evidence payloads are Available or Truncated; truncation keeps ID, fingerprint and references, and same-fingerprint SetEvidencePayload truncates or restores without change markers. Reads, discovery and plugin methods must distinguish a truncated payload from an absent ID.
sections: Decision / Payload availability is independent of evidence changes
Decision / One current captured value per evidence item

realised.evidence: PR #214 implements Available/Truncated payloads and fingerprint-checked SetEvidencePayload across guest codecs, persistence, reads and CLI

nodes.summary: Binary and large-text payloads are BlobRefs, not embedded content
nodes.detail: Binary and large-text payloads use typed BlobRefs under ADR 0029 rather than embedded contents; state.dhall stays metadata and typed values, never base64 bytes.
sections: Decision / One current captured value per evidence item

realised.evidence: No BlobRef in code by end of history; PR #214 explicitly defers blob storage

nodes.summary: Evidence state stores the connector's optional checked sync position
nodes.detail: Each instance's state document also stores the connector's optional checked sync position, published atomically with evidence (ADR 0029 owns its semantics).
sections: Decision / One current captured value per evidence item
Decision / Payload-free change tracking

realised.evidence: PR #203 persists typed connector sync positions atomically with evidence

nodes.summary: Graph Mail connector: immutable IDs, per-folder delta, capture-only
nodes.detail: A Mail connector captures newly encountered messages per mailbox using immutable message IDs and one delta continuation per configured folder, with since-based backfill, retention by truncation and no mirroring of deletions, moves or flags.
sections: Decision / Microsoft Graph mail, meeting artifacts and files

realised.evidence: microsoft-graph plugin has only Calendar; no MailConfig in code by end of history

nodes.summary: Teams meeting artifacts connector: every transcript and attendance report
nodes.detail: A meeting-artifacts connector captures every transcript and attendance report keyed by artifact kind, meeting and Graph ID, with no best-transcript selection or occurrence inference and a bounded look-back.
sections: Decision / Microsoft Graph mail, meeting artifacts and files

realised.evidence: No MeetingArtifact in code by end of history

nodes.summary: SharePoint/OneDrive files connector via drive delta with glob scope
nodes.detail: A files connector resolves site, drive or shared URL to IDs, follows drive-root delta filtered to a folder subtree and include globs, keys items by driveId/itemId and emits removals for deletions or scope exits.
sections: Decision / Microsoft Graph mail, meeting artifacts and files

realised.evidence: No FilesConfig in code by end of history

nodes.summary: Pending removals require explicit connector removal markers
nodes.detail: An absent ID is pending Removed only with an explicit unsuperseded connector removal marker; absence after cache clear or refetch never invents a deletion.
sections: Decision / Accepted progress and net pending evidence

realised.evidence: Superseded at seq 158 before any implementation

nodes.summary: Graph calendar uses calendarView delta over a fixed occurrence window
nodes.detail: The Calendar connector syncs the default calendar through calendarView delta over a configured fixed window, saving the opaque deltaLink as its position, using etag/changeKey, honouring @removed and restarting a full baseline on 410/syncStateNotFound.
sections: Decision / Microsoft Graph calendar acquisition

realised.evidence: PR #204 implements Calendar delta sync and restart with fake-server and live verification

nodes.summary: Persist current evidence and latest-fetch summary; no processing log
nodes.detail: Evidence state is current values, producer identity, sync position and one FetchSummary with counts; there is no acquisition log, removal-marker history, recipe watermark, acknowledgement register or pending/reconciliation result, so recipe curation bookkeeping is gone.
sections: Decision / Current evidence, not a processing log

realised.evidence: PR #210 removes pending/acknowledgement/curation machinery and historical evidence APIs and keeps one latest-fetch summary

nodes.summary: Generic current-evidence enumeration and reads alongside typed plugin methods
nodes.detail: listEvidenceIds/readEvidence and generated typed instance bindings let KB tools and recipe flows enumerate and read current evidence without a change list; CLI/MCP list and inspect items, and plugin methods remain optional richer views.
sections: Decision / Investigation reads the current evidence

realised.evidence: PR #210 adds current evidence listing/inspection and generated typed connector Evidence modules

nodes.summary: Each recipe owns an always-present typed state value
nodes.detail: A recipe is a method (OpenAgent/ClosedAgent) plus a typed state value whose contract comes from an authored type or the closed flow's signature, persisted per recipe; generated createRecipe/updateRecipe/removeRecipe handles create, migrate and remove it, with () for stateless recipes and no absent first-run state.
sections: Decision / Each recipe owns an always-present typed state

realised.evidence: State edits in #208/#209 (seqs 160-161); complete typed creation/migration in #210

nodes.summary: Recipe state changes only through reviewed evolutions
nodes.detail: A recipe-based evolution selects exactly one existing recipe and proposes facts plus its next state; creation and schema changes are ad hoc. State-only proposals are valid, state is reviewed with before/after contracts, and Kyyn never interprets state as a cursor or proof of processing.
sections: Decision / Recipe state changes only through evolutions

realised.evidence: PR #210 adds explicit AdHoc/RecipeBased workspaces with state in candidates and review archives

nodes.summary: Plugin change leaves recipe state untouched; no forced reconciliation
nodes.detail: A producer change replaces the capture and position on successful refetch, but recipe state is neither reset nor forced through reconciliation; authors decide how to adapt.
sections: Decision / Plugin changes and cache replacement

realised.evidence: PR #210 removes reconciliation machinery; state persists independently of evidence

nodes.summary: Graph content always downloaded; any download failure fails the whole fetch
nodes.detail: Mail captures each message once (drafts included) with readable text inline and every byte-backed attachment downloaded, with no size/media skip policy; files content is always a BlobRef. A failed page, hydration or download fails the whole fetch, leaving evidence and position unchanged, and mail retention is independent of recipe state.
sections: Decision / Microsoft Graph mail, meeting artifacts and files
Decision / One current captured value per evidence item

realised.evidence: No Mail or Files connector in code by end of history

nodes.summary: Blob references do not pin bytes against concurrent refresh or clear
nodes.detail: Invocation-local blob reads use the captured context, but references no longer keep bytes alive against a concurrent refresh or clear; ADR 0029 owns blob lifetime, which assumes non-overlapping tool use.
sections: Decision / Atomic refresh and invocation-local reads

realised.evidence: No blob storage in code by end of history

notes: The lane oscillated on evidence retention: founding said 'replaceable local cache' (seq 1); seq 76 swung to retaining every fetch delta with historical selection, fully implemented in #95 (seq 77); seven steps later seq 84 reverted to latest-only on Tom's explicit correction ('a KB current, not a forensic archive'), so the historical store, baselines and producer archives were built and torn out within days. Curation progress has an even larger arc: founding said no kernel review queue and that a KB models completeness with ordinary facts (0014.06); seq 76 proposed a KB-authored cursor (never built); seq 89 introduced host-owned recipe acknowledgements, a Git-tracked register and net pending discovery, all implemented and refined (91-93, 134-135 Reconciliation) and then removed at seq 158 in favour of recipe-owned typed state - effectively returning to the founding stance, with typed per-recipe state in place of 'ordinary facts'. Many nodes (0014.30-0014.39, 0014.45, 0014.46) were realised and superseded within about two weeks. 'No generic viewEvidence' (seq 76) was likewise reversed at seq 158 by generic listEvidenceIds/readEvidence, which also absorbed the seq-107 'evidence list' command. The Graph calendar design at seq 110 explicitly rejected calendarView; seq 157 reversed to calendarView delta after live performance work. Spec ahead of code at end of history: BlobRefs (0014.48, 0014.61) and the Mail, Teams meeting-artifact and SharePoint/OneDrive connectors (0014.50-0014.52, refined by 0014.60 at seq 164) are unrealised; payload availability (0014.47) was realised by PR #214 at seq 166 (cursor), and the sync-position slice (0014.49) by PR #203. Founding has no ### subsections, so it was split into ten distinct commitments (including the 'Updates and alternatives' plugin-change rule); merging was considered for 01-03 but their fates diverge. Judgement calls: 0014.06 is a negative constraint and is marked same_step at seq 1 because no queue existed; 0014.01 is dated to seq 87 when KB-side interpretation via typed tools landed (acquisition alone was proven at 78/81); the seq-158 rewrite is split into no-processing-log (55, which absorbs all acknowledgement/register/pending nodes), generic reads (56), typed recipe state (57, replacing the recipe-as-fact and Open/Closed nodes since the Recipe type became method+state), evolution-only state changes (58, replacing the RecipeChange report case) and plugin-change independence (59). Seq 164 (after the older inference) adds 0014.60 (whole-fetch failure, always-download Graph content) and 0014.61 (blob refs no longer pin bytes).
